race.description: Schneider - Atkore - Pipemakers Super Mdn Plate
race.comment: MAYFLOWER (7) makes her debut with a profile that commands respect, having won both trials this month and coming from a family with genuine stakes depth through Harlem Queen. The Michael Freedman and Jason Collett combination adds further polish, and she looks ready to make an immediate impact. BENSON (6) has the best race-day evidence among the lightly raced brigade after finishing second to Angel Hair at Hawkesbury on debut, where he was near the top of betting and handled soft ground. Schofield sticks and strips fitter. WILD COURAGE (10) was sound when fourth to Thorsten first-up at Newcastle, but she is open to second-up improvement and has enough exposed quality to be a clear danger despite the 1100m record asking a small question. BRUTAL ADVANCE (2) is the battle-hardened runner, with three seconds this campaign and a narrow last-start defeat behind Bold Bucks after being held up, though his long maiden record keeps him as a place hope.
